data.summary: Checked the documentation against the diff. The only stale statement was in ui/README.md: the feature list said privacy mode hides "monetary values and profit figures". This change makes privacy mode hide only monetary values, so I corrected that line to say percentages and profitability stay visible. The README's dark-theme, theme-toggle, header and component descriptions already match the code (Header.astro, PrivacyToggle.jsx, ThemeToggle.jsx and ui/ primitives exist). The repo has no CHANGELOG.md and no OpenAPI spec, and AGENTS.md states no facts this change invalidates. The docs/ HTML pages (landing page and privacy policy) do not describe the changed behaviour. No code, tests or build files were touched.

updatedFiles.description: Privacy mode feature bullet now says it hides monetary values only, and that percentages and profitability stay visible.

data.openApiNotes: No OpenAPI or Swagger spec exists in the repository, and the change does not alter any HTTP contract.
followUps: No CHANGELOG.md exists at the repository root or in ui/. I did not create one, since the plan does not ask for it. If the project starts keeping a changelog, the user-visible items here are dark mode, money-only privacy masking and zoom/pan on the investment and forecast charts.
CreateEntryModal preview still shows unmasked amounts in privacy mode, as the developer noted. This is a code change, so it is out of scope for the documentation agent.
